case_number: 2025 INSC 396; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No.5690 of 2020)
summary: Road rage confrontation; accused attacked during altercation initiated by deceased and group; no premeditation; single blow with iron rod to head; sudden provocation established; conviction under IPC s.302 set aside; reclassified under s.304 Part I; sentence reduced to 7 years RI; fine and default clause upheld; bail surrender in two months if not already served sentence.
final_judgment: Criminal Appeal allowed; conviction modified to IPC s.304 Part I; sentence reduced to 7 years rigorous imprisonment; fine and default clause maintained; appellant to surrender within two months if not already completed sentence.
